svg.title: Outbound dock floor plan, before and after
svg.desc: Floor plan of a cold-storage outbound dock: a tangled dashed path shows the old back-and-forth handling; six straight rust arrows show the redesigned flow from racking through numbered staging lanes to the trucks. A note reads: dock-to-truck time down 23 percent, zero safety incidents.
